semantics.identity: GSIS player_id only; FB/HB normalized to RB
semantics.observations: Recorded stat rows only. No row does not establish a zero game, activity, roster membership, or health.
semantics.missing_stats: null is unavailable, not zero; fumbles_lost_total is not fumbles_total
semantics.completion: completed includes reported-score-pair inference; inspect completion_basis. Only explicit final evidence clears provisional.
semantics.analysis_ready: Archived stats plus a reported score pair at least 8 hours after kickoff, or explicit final evidence. This is not certified final status.
semantics.revisions: Saved statistics may be corrected; source collection dates and checksums are preserved, not backdated.
